references.text: Continuation of the instructions regarding the distribution of the land, explaining that larger tribes shall receive a larger inheritance and smaller tribes a smaller one, and that lots shall be used.
Repeats the principle that the land is to be distributed as an inheritance by casting lots according to the size of the tribes.
Moses commands that the land be distributed as an inheritance to the nine and a half tribes by casting lots.
The fulfillment of the promise when Joshua took all the land and gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their tribal divisions.
Describes how the children of Israel received their inheritance in the land of Canaan by casting lots, as commanded through Moses.
Ezekiel's prophecy about a future distribution of the land among the tribes of Israel as an inheritance.
